claims.text: @ risk of AS or aSx AS (B/C): tx HTN per strd GDMT, start ↓ and titrate up gradually, w monitoring.
claims.quote: In patients at risk of developing AS (Stage A) and in patients with asymptomatic AS (Stages B and C), hypertension should be treated according to standard GDMT, started at a low dose, and gradually titrated upward as needed, with appropriate clinical monitoring.
